landing.title: Personalized Smart Farming & Resource Advisory System
landing.subtitle: Sign up or log in to get customized crop suitability recommendations, live district weather telemetry, financial ROI forecasts, and government scheme guidance tailored to your exact farm.
landing.feature1Desc: Save your district, soil type, land size, and water source once. Every recommendation is custom-tailored to your farm.
landing.feature2Desc: Intelligent suitability scoring out of 100 based on soil compatibility, Kuruvai/Samba/Navarai season, and water access.
landing.feature3Desc: Real-time district weather telemetry and weather-aware advice (rain warnings, heatwave alerts, spraying advisories).
landing.feature4Desc: Accurate cost estimation for scaled NPK fertilizers, seeds, labor, net profit, ROI %, and applicable TN subsidies.
landing.feature5Desc: Multi-threaded Java concurrency simulation demonstrating synchronized reservoir allocation and CountDownLatch gating.

water.title: Shared Reservoir Canal Water Allocation
water.subtitle: 5-Thread Java concurrency simulation executing simultaneous canal sluice gate requests.
water.info: 5 canal channels request 15 KL each simultaneously from a 50 KL reservoir using CountDownLatch synchronization. Exactly 3 channels are granted (45 KL) and 2 are denied. Thread execution order varies on each run.
